verdict.rationale: Vanta documents ISO 27001 as a first-party framework: it says it helps customers certify to ISO 27001, offers AI-powered ISMS templates, and provides generic audit tooling such as the Auditor API and Information Request Lists. The evidence never mentions the current Annex A control set or a Statement of Applicability, so first-class depth beyond marketing claims is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit Annex A (current revision) control set, Statement of Applicability support, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Vanta helps you certify to ISO 27001 quickly and easily, so you can prove your security posture to prospects and customers around the world.
Build your ISMS faster with AI-powered templates for roles, responsibilities, and risks—no heavy consulting required.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and 35+ frameworks—automated and continuously monitored.
Use it to list active audits, pull controls and evidence, manage information requests, and review the resources, personnel, and monitored computers in scope for each engagement.
